title: Ambient ringed exchange
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square],

$$
 \begin{array}{ccc}
 X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\\
 f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
 Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y
 \end{array}
$$

with its chosen identification; of it only the equality $f\circ g'=g\circ f'$ is used. Let a coefficient sheaf be given on each corner: a sheaf of rings $R_T$ on the small pro-etale site $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] for $T\in\{X,Y,X',Y'\}$, with identifications $f^{-1}R_Y\cong R_X$, $g^{-1}R_Y\cong R_{Y'}$, $g'^{-1}R_X\cong R_{X'}$, $f'^{-1}R_{Y'}\cong R_{X'}$ of pro-etale inverse images [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] such that the two resulting identifications $(fg')^{-1}R_Y\cong R_{X'}$ and $(gf')^{-1}R_Y\cong R_{X'}$ agree (a commutative square of ringed pro-etale topoi). For each edge $u$ use the derived module pullback and derived direct image with their adjunction $Lu^*\dashv Ru_*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]; let $\varepsilon_f:Lf^*Rf_*\to\mathrm{id}$ be the counit of $Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$. Let

$$
 \theta_\square:Lf'^*Lg^*\xrightarrow{c_{f',g}^{-1}}L(g\circ f')^*=L(f\circ g')^*\xrightarrow{c_{g',f}}Lg'^*Lf^*
$$

be the isomorphism of functors $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},R_Y)\to D(X'_{\mathrm{proet}},R_{X'})$ built from the composition isomorphisms of derived pullbacks [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. The *ambient pro-etale exchange transformation*

$$
 \Ex^R_{\square}:Lg^*Rf_*\longrightarrow Rf'_*Lg'^*
$$

of functors $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},R_X)\to D(Y'_{\mathrm{proet}},R_{Y'})$ is the mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of $\theta_\square$ with respect to the adjunctions $Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$ and $Lf'^*\dashv Rf'_*$ and the functors $G=Lg^*$, $H=Lg'^*$; that is, the transformation whose transpose under $Lf'^*\dashv Rf'_*$ is

$$
 Lf'^*Lg^*Rf_*\xrightarrow{\theta_\square Rf_*}
 Lg'^*Lf^*Rf_*\xrightarrow{Lg'^*\varepsilon_f}Lg'^*,
$$

explicitly $Lg^*Rf_*K\xrightarrow{\eta_{f'}}Rf'_*Lf'^*Lg^*Rf_*K\xrightarrow{Rf'_*\theta_\square}Rf'_*Lg'^*Lf^*Rf_*K\xrightarrow{Rf'_*Lg'^*\varepsilon_{f,K}}Rf'_*Lg'^*K$ with $\eta_{f'}$ the unit of $Lf'^*\dashv Rf'_*$. It is defined before any completeness or constructibility condition.

mathlib_searches.results: only BaseChange of coverings/precoverages (Sites/Precoverage.lean, Sites/MorphismProperty.lean, ...); no cohomological base change map of ringed sites
AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Proetale.lean (topology only); Adjunction.derived gives G' ⊣ F' for absolute derived functors, but no derived pullback/pushforward of pro-etale modules and no exchange map
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match; the mate itself is CategoryTheory.mateEquiv (node def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate)

split_report.summary: Checked against Stacks Remark 07A7 (sites-cohomology.tex, remark-base-change), which defines the base change map Lg^*Rf_*K -> Rf'_*Lg'^*K of a commutative square of ringed topoi exactly as the blueprint does: adjoint to L(g')^* of the counit after L(f')^*Lg^* = L(g')^*Lf^*. Made the statement explicit: the coefficient sheaves on the four corners with compatible identifications (the blueprint's 'a coefficient sheaf R'), the isomorphism theta built from the composition isomorphisms of derived pullbacks (Stacks 0D6D; the blueprint's unlabelled '~'), and the mate in the sense of CategoryTheory.mateEquiv with G = Lg^*, H = Lg'^*. Only commutativity fg' = gf' of the cartesian square is used. Statement dependencies: the cartesian square, the pro-etale site and inverse image (for the coefficient identifications), the derived operations with the adjunction Lu^* -| Ru_* (def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, which carries units and counits), and two new nodes: lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition (unsplit, Stacks 0D6D; Mathlib has only the underived SheafOfModules.pullbackComp) and def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate (Mathlib leaf, CategoryTheory.mateEquiv). The Mathlib notion of adjunction with unit and counit is recorded in the mate node's match.
